brief: Founder distribution: how I turn 1 carousel into 12 assets across 4 platforms — automated.

slots.body: Founders waste hours manually resizing content for every platform. Here's the automated system I use to multiply reach.

slots.title: Build the
slots.body: Design one data-driven carousel in Figma or Canva. Make it dense with value. This single file feeds every platform format automatically.

slots.title: Vertical clips for
slots.body: Export each slide as a 9:16 video strip. Add captions and motion. You now have 3 Reels, 3 Shorts, and 3 TikToks ready to publish.

slots.title: Square tiles for
slots.body: Crop to 1:1 for Instagram carousel posts and LinkedIn image docs. The square format drives the highest engagement on desktop and mobile feeds.

slots.title: Widescreen for
slots.body: Reformat to 16:9 or 4:5 for X threads and LinkedIn document carousels. Horizontal reads better on desktop timelines and newsletter embeds.

slots.title: Extract quote
slots.body: Pull the strongest hooks and data points. Turn them into branded story graphics. These become atomic posts for LinkedIn and Instagram Stories.

slots.title: Schedule and
slots.body: Use Make or Zapier to push every variant to Buffer or Hootsuite. One upload triggers twelve assets across four platforms on autopilot.
Save ten hours a week. Drop your email below and I'll send you the exact automation template I use to scale content.
